description.value: Uptown Pizza is a sit-down pizza and Italian restaurant offering an unusually broad menu spanning classic and specialty pizzas, stuffed pastas, seafood dishes, wings, burgers, and more. The restaurant has both indoor and outdoor seating and accepts online orders for pickup and delivery. Its extensive menu makes it a substantial refuelling stop for cyclists seeking a full meal rather than a quick snack.
